verdicts.opus: D traced nearly every number to the single comparison call and computed exact ratios. It also flagged the record's own anomaly: the off-topic depression paper returned as claim A's strongest source. A and B gave reasonable clinical verdicts from memory but no measured balance, and A's citations contain fabricated venue and DOI details.
verdicts.gpt: B is strongest because it turns the recorded comparison into a reproducible, correctly caveated contrast and clearly distinguishes corpus volume from clinical truth. Its chart and exports are useful, though the database has no explicit window and the clinical evidence remains unresolved; the other deliverables either rely on unverified specifics or omit the measured comparison.

claude_prism.drilldown: Provides one traced breakdown layer; only one of six proposed follow-ups executed successfully, so the required executable coverage is absent.
